title: Virtual tripwire / line-crossing detection
description: alerts when any object crosses an operator-defined line, in a chosen direction.

title: Zone / restricted-area intrusion
description: alerts on entry into a drawn polygon (a room, a fence line, a runway).

title: Multi-zone geofencing rules
description: different rules and schedules per zone (e.g., armed after hours only).

title: Fence-climb / scale detection
description: distinguishes a person climbing a barrier from one merely walking near it.

title: Wrong-direction / contraflow detection
description: flags motion against an expected direction (exit-only doors, one-way lanes).

title: Loitering detection
description: alerts when a person or vehicle remains in an area beyond a configurable dwell time.

title: Abandoned-object detection
description: flags a bag, box or vehicle left unattended beyond a threshold time.

title: Object-removal detection
description: flags when a fixed asset (e.g., a painting, equipment) disappears from frame.

title: Camera tamper / obstruction / defocus detection
description: detects blocked, sprayed, redirected or defocused cameras and raises a health alert.

title: Person detection & classification
description: distinguishes people from other movement; some vendors sub-classify (adult/child, uniformed staff).

title: Vehicle detection & classification
description: car / truck / van / motorcycle / bicycle sub-typing.

title: Multi-class object detection
description: bags, packages, tools, ladders, animals and other defined object classes.

title: Multi-object tracking within a camera
description: maintains a stable ID for a subject as it moves through a single field of view.

title: Cross-camera re-identification / journey tracking
description: appearance-based matching to follow a subject across non-overlapping cameras.

title: Attribute-based search
description: search by clothing colour, bag presence, vehicle colour/type, etc., without needing a name or plate.

title: 1:N watchlist matching
description: matches live faces against VIP, banned-person or persons-of-interest lists in real time.

title: Masked / partially-occluded face recognition
description: maintained match accuracy when a subject wears a mask or hat.

title: Age and gender estimation
description: coarse demographic inference used for both security and retail analytics.

title: Face-triggered access control
description: unlocks a door or logs an event on a positive/negative watchlist match.

title: Auto-enrolment and de-duplication
description: automatically creates or merges biometric profiles from repeat visits.

title: Liveness / anti-spoofing detection
description: rejects photo, video-replay or mask spoofing attempts at recognition points.

title: Plate character OCR
description: reads plate characters across day/night and multiple regional plate formats.

title: Vehicle make / model / colour / type classification
description: enriches the plate read with vehicle attributes for search and reporting.

title: Hotlist / watchlist plate alerts
description: real-time alert when a stolen, wanted or banned plate is read.

title: Parking session tracking & enforcement
description: entry/exit time-stamping, overstay and unpaid-session alerts.

title: Free-flow tolling / multi-lane free-flow (MLFF) support
description: high-speed multi-lane plate capture for barrier-free tolling.

title: Historical plate search & travel-pattern analysis
description: queries by plate, date range, camera or route to reconstruct a vehicle's movements.

title: Aggression / fight detection
description: flags physical altercations between two or more people.

title: Fall detection
description: detects a person collapsing to the ground (widely used in eldercare and hospitals).

title: Crowd / mob-formation detection
description: flags unusual grouping or rapid crowd build-up.

title: Running / sudden-movement detection
description: flags atypical speed or motion patterns.

title: Tailgating / piggybacking detection
description: flags a second, unbadged person following through an access-controlled door.

title: Suspicious shopping / concealment behaviour
description: retail-specific gesture and dwell patterns associated with theft.

title: Duress / panic-gesture detection
description: recognises distress signals such as raised-hands or specific duress gestures.

title: Visible firearm detection
description: identifies rifles and pistols in frame, typically in well under one second.

title: Knife / edged-weapon detection
description: identifies bladed weapons distinct from firearms.

title: Concealed-weapon cues / sensor fusion
description: optional integration with millimetre-wave or X-ray screening for concealed threats.

title: Human-verified alert escalation
description: a trained analyst reviews and confirms AI detections before dispatch, cutting false positives.

title: Automated lockdown / webhook triggers
description: auto-locks doors, sounds PA alarms, or notifies staff on a confirmed threat.

title: Law-enforcement / emergency-dispatch integration
description: direct hand-off of location, time and image to 911/RapidSOS-style dispatch.

title: PPE detection
description: hard hats, hi-vis vests, gloves, harnesses and face coverings on a jobsite.

title: Hazard-proximity alerts
description: flags a worker entering an unsafe distance from machinery, forklifts or edges.

title: Fire and smoke detection
description: camera-based early detection, complementing or substituting point sensors.

title: Slip / trip hazard detection
description: flags spills, obstructions or fall-risk conditions on walkways.

title: Confined-space / restricted-zone monitoring
description: tracks worker presence and duration in hazardous or permit-required areas.

title: Vehicle–pedestrian proximity alerts
description: warns when people and forklifts/vehicles converge in warehouse or yard zones.

title: Real-time occupancy counting & capacity limits
description: live headcount against a maximum-occupancy threshold.

title: Bi-directional entry/exit counting
description: separate in/out tallies at doors, gates or turnstiles.

title: Crowd-density heatmaps
description: visualises where people concentrate across a site over time.

title: Queue length & wait-time measurement
description: tracks queue formation and average service/wait time.

title: Space-utilisation / distancing analytics
description: measures spacing patterns, still used for capacity and flow planning.

title: Footfall & unique-visitor counting
description: counts total and de-duplicated visits per period.

title: Dwell time by zone or aisle
description: measures how long shoppers spend in specific areas.

title: Conversion-rate correlation
description: combines footfall with POS data to calculate visitor-to-sale conversion.

title: Demographic estimation for merchandising
description: age-range/gender mix by zone or time of day.

title: Store-layout heatmaps
description: guides fixture and promotional placement using traffic patterns.

title: Staff-customer interaction & service-time analytics
description: measures staff availability and engagement at counters.

title: Shrinkage / loss-prevention analytics
description: flags self-checkout exceptions, sweethearting, and other loss patterns.

title: Queue-triggered staffing alerts
description: notifies managers to open counters when queues exceed a threshold.

title: Natural-language / text-to-video search
description: plain-English queries across indexed footage ("red truck, north gate, last night").

title: Video synopsis
description: compresses hours of footage into a short, overlapping-event summary for fast review.

title: Appearance / attribute-based search
description: finds a person or vehicle by colour and attribute rather than by time-scrubbing.

title: Multi-camera timeline reconstruction
description: stitches a subject's path across cameras into one investigation timeline.

title: Evidence export with watermark / chain-of-custody
description: tamper-evident export for legal and law-enforcement use.

title: Case management & secure sharing
description: organizes clips, notes and access logs per investigation, shareable with authorities.

title: Low-light / starlight imaging support
description: maintains detection accuracy in near-dark conditions.

title: Thermal-camera integration
description: fuses thermal and visible-light feeds for detection in zero-light or smoke conditions.

title: Drone / UAV feed ingestion
description: extends detection pipelines to aerial video for large sites or events.

title: Multi-sensor fusion
description: combines video with audio, radar, mmWave or access-control signals to cut false alarms.

title: Fisheye / panoramic dewarping
description: corrects wide-angle lens distortion before running analytics.

title: Outdoor/weather-robust tuning
description: reduces false triggers from rain, fog, foliage motion and glare.

title: ONVIF / RTSP compatibility
description: works with third-party cameras and NVRs rather than requiring a full hardware refresh.

title: VMS / PSIM plug-in architecture
description: certified integrations with platforms such as Milestone, Genetec or Bosch VMS.

title: Open REST API / SDK / webhooks
description: lets integrators and clients build custom workflows on top of detections.

title: Access-control & alarm-panel integration
description: ties detections into door locks, PA systems and alarm panels.

title: Edge / on-prem / cloud / hybrid deployment
description: flexible inference location depending on bandwidth, latency and data-residency needs.

title: Multi-site centralised dashboard & role-based access
description: single pane of glass across sites with permissioned user roles.

title: Mobile app & live-link sharing
description: remote viewing and short-lived shareable links for first responders or stakeholders.

title: Scalability from single-camera to city-wide
description: architecture that scales from one site to thousands of cameras.

title: Configurable retention & auto-purge
description: automated deletion or anonymisation once the retention window lapses.

title: Face / plate privacy masking & redaction
description: blurs identifiable data in exports for privacy-compliant sharing.

title: Role-based access & audit logging
description: tracks who viewed, exported or deleted footage and when.

title: Encryption at rest and in transit
description: protects stored footage and live streams from interception or tampering.

title: Bias / accuracy testing & model documentation
description: published accuracy and fairness testing to support procurement and legal review.

title: Consent management & signage support
description: tools to manage and document notice/consent where required.

title: Regulatory compliance mapping
description: alignment with PDPA (Malaysia), GDPR (EU), and hardware sourcing rules such as US NDAA/TAA.

title: Custom / trainable models per site
description: fine-tuning detection models on a client's own footage and object classes.

title: Operator feedback loop
description: false-positive/negative tagging that improves the model over time.

title: Multi-model orchestration
description: pipelines that chain detection, classification, tracking and re-identification models.

title: Edge vs. cloud inference switching
description: runs models on-camera/on-NVR or in the cloud depending on load and connectivity.

title: Model versioning & explainability reporting
description: traceability of which model version produced which alert, for audits and tuning.
